verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence of a robots.txt on the Secretary of State's own domain (coloradosos.gov). The only robots reference is a crawl-delay on data.colorado.gov, which the probe describes as the Socrata open-data platform "rather than the registry itself." That is a host-platform capability and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
